enforcement_note: Nothing runs the sync. SessionStart reports the branch, dirty state and ahead/behind counts (handle_session_start -> git_status), which surfaces the need; running `git fetch && git pull --rebase` and stopping on a dirty tree is the agent's discipline. A PreToolUse hook could enforce it; none does.
rule: Run git fetch and pull --rebase before any work; if the tree is dirty, ask the user how to proceed.
ai_action: Run `git fetch && git pull --rebase`. On a dirty tree, stop and ask.
